prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent PNG energy-shield VFX overlay worn by a major boss in a polished Japanese anime bullet-hell game. Not a collectible, not a handheld shield, not a UI frame.
Primary request: an imposing crimson-and-champagne-gold crystalline barrier cocoon. ONLY the empty upright barrier; the animated boss will be rendered through its transparent center. A near-round vertically oval cage made of six broad separated curved crystal armor segments, three along either flank, each with sharp bevels, ruby-red translucent glass, bright coral luminous edges and thin champagne-gold metallic tracing. Top and bottom arcs are deliberately thinner to leave room for the boss face and feet. A fine secondary luminous energy contour just inside the plates gives a premium double-layered force-field appearance. Strong clean anime VFX painting, rich material depth, distinct larger facets that remain legible when shrunk to 85 pixels tall. White-gold highlights concentrated at the side facets, never in the empty middle. The side armor should feel like a powerful active defensive barrier, not an ornate picture frame.
Composition: one centered symmetric upright oval, total silhouette width 84% of square canvas and height 90%; clean contained margins. Open transparent central region occupies at least 58% canvas width and 65% canvas height, no crisscrossing lines in the middle. Side armor relatively narrow so it does not hide the boss sprite. No disconnected debris; clean edges and localized soft glow.
Transparency: genuine transparent alpha PNG; outside AND inside completely transparent. No colored fill behind the ring, no background matte or checkerboard pattern. Preserve partial alpha on the glow and glass.
Avoid: characters, people, monsters, props, words, letters, logos, watermark, HUD, scenery, floor, crown symbol, shield crest, center jewel, starbursts, beams across the center, opaque disk, excessive filigree or tiny noisy details.
